Name: Vin's Navi Fairy
Author: BaneOfDagon
Description:
I thought of Navi as soon as I saw the fairy trinket! This is my second mod so I hope it works well, I might add little sparkles under Navi sometime in the future.

How to Download:
-Have SMAPI and Content Patcher downloaded (obviously lol)
-Install the mod and place it in the mods folder
-Run the game with SMAPI
-Navi :D

How to Uninstall:
-Delete "(CP) Vin's Navi Fairy" from the mods folder
-No Navi D:

Make sure to check the changelog and report any bugs! Thank you!

Downloads.Description: Patched for the 1.6.4 update, make sure to read the changelog (hehe)
